evidence.title: [2609.03884] A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors
A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust: When Attacker-Controlled Hook Updates Steer AI Agent Harnesses towards Malicious Behaviors

name: A Blind Trust, the Bloody Thrust
summary: arXiv security paper on HookPry, an attack that trojanizes agent plugins through trusted lifecycle-hook updates to run attacker commands.
description: Lifecycle hooks bind shell commands to AI agent runtime events and run with host privileges outside the model's decision path; the paper identifies this update path as a supply-chain attack surface. HookPry combines adversarial manifest optimization, temporal decoupling and a least-common-interface compiler, compromising all seven tested harnesses (up to 92.5% success across 1,000 runs) while Microsoft Defender scored 0% recall.
